await page.evaluate('()=>{const chan=v=>{v/=255;return v<=.04045?v/12.92:((v+.055)/1.055)**2.4},lum=rgb=>rgb.slice(0,3).map(chan).reduce((a,v,i)=>a+v*[.2126,.7152,.0722][i],0),rgb=s=>(s.match(/[\\d.]+/g)||[]).map(Number),ratio=(a,b)=>{const x=lum(a),y=lum(b);return (Math.max(x,y)+.05)/(Math.min(x,y)+.05)};const failures=[];let min=100,count=0;for(const e of document.querySelectorAll(\'.unfoolable main p,.unfoolable main small,.unfoolable main summary,.unfoolable main a\')){if(!e.getClientRects().length||e.closest(\'[hidden]\'))continue;const cs=getComputedStyle(e);if(cs.visibility===\'hidden\')continue;let parent=e,bg;while(parent){const v=rgb(getComputedStyle(parent).backgroundColor);if(v.length===3||v[3]===1){bg=v;break;}parent=parent.parentElement;}if(!bg)continue;const row=e.closest(\'[data-attention=true]\');if(row){const hex=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfoolable\')).getPropertyValue(\'--uf-amber\').trim().slice(1);const tint=[0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(hex.slice(i,i+2),16));bg=bg.slice(0,3).map((v,i)=>.95*v+.05*tint[i]);}const n=ratio(rgb(cs.color),bg);min=Math.min(min,n);count++;if(n<4.5)failures.push({text:e.textContent.slice(0,70),ratio:n});}if(visualViewport.scale!==1||devicePixelRatio!==1||getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).zoom!==\'1\'||!count||min<4.5||document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth||document.getAnimations().some(a=>a.playState===\'running\'))throw Error(JSON.stringify({count,min,failures,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth-innerWidth}));return {width:innerWidth,scrollWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,minSecondaryContrast:min,secondaryNodes:count,failures,runningAnimations:document.getAnimations().filter(a=>a.playState===\'running\').length,zoom:visualViewport.scale,cssZoom:getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).zoom,deviceScale:devicePixelRatio,buttonHeight:document.querySelector(\'.unfool-ask button\').getBoundingClientRect().height,columnWidth:document.querySelector(\'.unfool-column\').getBoundingClientRect().width,bodyFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfoolable\')).fontSize,titleFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfool-task h2\')).fontSize,statusFont:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(\'.unfool-status\')).fontSize,visibleTicketRows:document.querySelectorAll(\'.unfool-task\').length,marks:[...document.querySelectorAll(\'.hallmark-well\')].map(x=>x.getAttribute(\'aria-label\'))};}');
```
